name: Pizza Casserole
description: A hearty pizza-inspired casserole with pasta, pepperoni, and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Melt margarine and sauté chopped onion until soft.
Add tomato sauce, mushrooms, oregano, and basil. Stir and remove from heat.
Cook pasta in boiling water with oil and salt for 8 to 10 minutes until tender but firm. Drain.
Combine cooked pasta with Parmesan cheese and 1 cup mozzarella cheese in a 3-quart casserole.
Scatter pepperoni slices over the pasta mixture.
Cover with the tomato-onion sauce and sprinkle with remaining mozzarella cheese.
Bake, uncovered, in a 350°F oven for 30 minutes.

keywords: pizza casserole, pasta bake, pepperoni, mozzarella cheese

_similar.name: Garfield's Lasagna
_similar.description: A hearty layered lasagna with ground beef, cottage cheese, and mozzarella, perfect for a crowd.
recipeIngredient: 10 oz can mushroom pieces and stems

recipeInstructions.text: Thoroughly brown the ground beef in a frying pan. Add onions and garlic; cook until tender.
Add spaghetti sauce, diced tomatoes, mushrooms, oregano, and salt. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook lasagna noodles as directed on the package. Rinse noodles in cold water using a colander.
Blend cottage cheese with approximately 2 cups of the mozzarella cheese.
Spread a thin layer of sauce in a greased 9x13 inch pan. Alternately layer 1/3 each of the noodles, sauce, and cheese mixture. Repeat 2 times until you have 3 layers.
Sprinkle remaining mozzarella cheese on top. Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

_similar.keywords: lasagna, ground beef, cottage cheese, mozzarella, layered pasta

recipeInstructions.text: Combine cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in a bowl.
Spread 1½ cups of spaghetti sauce in the bottom of a 13x9x2 inch pan.
Arrange a layer of uncooked lasagna noodles on top of the sauce, overlapping slightly.
Sprinkle half of the mozzarella cheese and half of the cottage cheese mixture over the noodles.
Repeat with another layer of sauce, noodles, and the remaining cheeses.
Cover the top with sauce and cover tightly with heavy foil.
Set on a jelly roll pan and bake.

_similar.name: Pizza
_similar.description: A homemade pizza recipe with a yeast-based crust, topped with spaghetti sauce, various meats, and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Dissolve yeast in warm water with sugar. Let stand in a warm place for 10 minutes.
Measure flour and salt into a large bowl. Make a well and pour in the yeast mixture. Stir and add oil gradually, working the dough until thoroughly mixed.
Knead the dough, form into a ball, and let stand in a warm place for approximately 45 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Roll out the dough on a floured pastry board to an even thickness. Transfer to a pizza pan or cookie sheet.
Cover with spaghetti sauce, meats, mushrooms, and other toppings. Finish with mozzarella cheese.
Bake for approximately 20 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Let stand for 3 to 5 minutes before cutting and serving.

_similar.name: Jelly Roll Style Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A creative meat loaf recipe shaped like a jelly roll, filled with mozzarella cheese and baked in a loaf pan.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup cracker crumbs or dry bread crumbs

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients except ground beef in a large bowl, using only 1 cup of mozzarella cheese.
Add ground beef and mix thoroughly with hands until just combined.
Shape the mixture into a 10x12 inch rectangle on waxed paper.
Sprinkle 2 cups of mozzarella cheese over the meat.
Roll up the mixture like a jelly roll using the waxed paper and press ends together to seal.
Place the foil-wrapped jelly roll in a meat loaf pan and bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour.
Drain off fat and pour reserved tomato sauce on the roll.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before slicing.
Decorate with tomato slices and green parsley on a serving tray.

_similar.keywords: meat loaf, jelly roll, mozzarella cheese, baked
